divtop

divtop (top-of-div elements) groups elements which can occur at the start of any division class element.
Member of classes (none)  
Members argument byline dateline docAuthor docDate epigraph head opener salute signed
Declaration 
<!ENTITY % x.divtop "" >
<!ENTITY % m.divtop "%x.divtop; %n.argument; | %n.byline; | %n.dateline; | 
%n.docAuthor; | %n.docDate; | %n.epigraph; | %n.head; | %n.opener; | %n.salute; | 
%n.signed;">
Attributes Global attributes only
